title: lint: page sorts naming an unknown field get no reader on element dataSource.sort / app page record.sort, and stay warning elsewhere while the door answers 400
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filed from PR #30084 (card #30023, lint judges stored sorts), contract review PASS at `c745679c`, 2026-11-04. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.

Business reason: the existence check on stored page sorts is uneven, and older than #30084.
- `validate-page-field-bindings` reads a block's `sort` and `interfaceConfig.sort`, but only at `warning`.
- Nothing reads an element's `dataSource.sort` or an app page's `record.sort` for an unknown field name.

Either way the page publishes green, and its first read answers `400 INVALID_SORT` at the list door. The author learns of the problem from a broken page instead of from `os validate` or the publish door.

Reader who acts: `packages/lint` owner (`validate-page-field-bindings.ts`, `validate-sortable-fields.ts`).

## What to do
- Add `page-field-unknown` readers for element `dataSource.sort`, `parentDataSource.sort` and app page `record.sort`, bound to the same object the renderer reads (`dataSource.object ?? block prop`, and `interfaceConfig.source ?? page.object`).
- Decide the severity of an unknown sort field on every page slot. The door answers 400, so `error` matches the read. A warning-to-error move is a narrowing and owes its ADR-0087 disposition.

Dedupe: `page sort unknown field`, `page-field-unknown sort severity`. **New.**
